matching.metric: signed change in alpha-weighted local luminance contrast RMS from unchanged developed input
matching.roi: Top three quarters, excluding input pair differences >= 0.08; clarity pair distance 4 and texture 1. Bottom-quarter noise residual and strong-edge halo strips are separate. Fine detail in strong-edge fixtures supplies effect matching away from the main boundary. For lowlight-noise the matching input and outputs use the known clean ground-truth counterpart, never the noisy signal. Exclude an input-defined square margin max(4, 0.05 * width) around input neighbor boundaries > 0.1 linear Y so output halo gradients cannot satisfy detail matching. V2 primary scenes instead use only the explicit independent neutral detail-probe ROI; all other scene masks remain V1.
matching.toleranceRule: Same nonzero sign, abs(target) >= minimumAbsoluteTarget, absolute error <= max(maximumAbsoluteDeltaError, maximumRelativeDeltaError * abs(target)).
matching.acceptanceRule: Freeze a signed parameter per scene, direction and variant on the tuning fixture; measure acceptance without refitting. The mapping is an experimental normalization, not a universal slider mapping.

primary.aggregation: Separate clarity and texture gates; equal-weight mean of the two strong-edge scenes and +/-20 directions. Every matched case must avoid the absolute regression cap; +/-60 stress cases only supply matched critical vetoes.
primary.reference: Input-defined strong-edge support against the same-side output plateau, excluding the detail matching region and the bottom-quarter noise ROI. An empty halo ROI is missing evidence. Dark-side and bright-side sample counts must both be nonzero; unsupported narrow-branch interiors cannot establish dark-side halo quality.

ablations.clarity: Guided log-luminance versus Gaussian log-luminance at identical sigma and finish formula.
ablations.texture: Identical Gaussian sigma/boundary treatment: existing gamma-2.2/additive domain after linear RGB Gaussian, unbounded log EV detail, and log detail limited to +/-1 EV with tame. Domain and limiter comparisons have independently matched signed effect targets.
ablations.textureAdoption: Require primary gain over PicEdit and same-Gaussian existing-domain variant. Report incremental limiter gain over unlimited log separately; no automatic transfer of a clarity decision to texture.

criticalComparison: Only matched production candidates can veto their own control. Hue/gamut/clipping/alpha and edge overshoot compare to PicEdit. Noise amplification uses an independent bottom-quarter noisy/clean residual; excluded from effect matching. No halo/noise credit from absent or empty ROIs.
decisionOrder: A verified matched critical regression, attributable performance violation or completed matched primary without the required gain is no-go for that control.
Otherwise absent complete matching, scene, visual, performance or integration evidence is blocked, never go.
Clarity and texture are independent; texture must additionally demonstrate a same-Gaussian ablation benefit. Production integration requires Go and LC02.
requiredMissingUntilMeasured: Licensed real portraits, backlit natural edges, masonry/textiles and high-ISO photographs
Production cache, rapid slider/image changes, cancellation, undo and preview/export integration
Accelerated path parity if an accelerated path is proposed
criticalLimitRationale: Hue, gamut, clipping and alpha reuse LC01/LC03 limits. A 0.03 additional linear-Y edge overshoot is the predeclared maximum per-pixel halo regression against PicEdit. The independent noisy/clean residual may increase by at most 2% at matched fine-detail gain; this conservative non-regression guard is not a claimed perceptual just-noticeable difference. Thresholds are fixed before measurements.
neutralContract: Every scene and variant emits -1/0/+1 diagnostics. Exactly zero must preserve the input raster hash; this identity contract is checked separately from nonzero effect matching. Missing transition records block acceptance; a verified candidate zero-identity regression rejects that control.

primaryDetailProbe.reason: V1 primary scenes had texture targets below the registered minimum and hard-edge area changes shifted the clarity fit. V2 changes only independent probe support; algorithms, matching/quality thresholds and decisions remain fixed.
primaryDetailProbe.placement: Upper half only; retain every lower-half V1 pixel, including the halo ROI and its plateau anchors.
primaryDetailProbe.signal: Neutral linear RGB .18 + .02*sin(2*pi*x/8)*cos(2*pi*y/8) + .02*sin(2*pi*x/32)*cos(2*pi*y/32), at 512x320. Tuning phase(0,0), acceptance(3,5) pixel cyclic translations; coordinates scale with dimensions.

matchingROIAt512x320.appliesTo: Pair start positions; endpoint may extend 1 or 4 pixels into the surrounding probe. The existing strong-edge mask still excludes both endpoints.

primaryDetailProbe.contract: Fixed whole-period independent ROI, same input RMS and pair counts across splits. Do not adjust the probe after V2 outcomes.
